section.content: The present disclosure relates to a machine learning system and a machine learning method. The machine learning system includes a display device and a learning device. The learning device causes a variable selection unit in a learning execution screen of the display device to display a result of extracting an interpretation variable candidate and a destination variable candidate from a target file designated by a user. The learning device causes a result display unit in a learning execution screen to display a result obtained by machine learning to analyze the relationship between the target variable and the explanatory variable selected by the user from among the explanatory variable candidates and the target variable candidates displayed in the variable selection unit.
本公开涉及一种机器学习系统和机器学习方法。机器学习系统具备显示装置和学习装置。学习装置使显示装置的学习执行画面中的变量选择部显示从由用户指定的对象文件中提取解释变量候补和目的变量候补的结果。学习装置使学习执行画面中的结果显示部显示通过机器学习分析用户从显示于变量选择部的解释变量候补和目的变量候补中选择出的解释变量和目的变量的关系性而得到的结果。

Machine learning system and machine learning methodTechnical Field

The present disclosure relates to a machine learning system and a machine learning method.

Background

For example, japanese patent application laid-open No. 2023-34011 describes a technique for optimizing control parameters in a manufacturing process of a battery using machine learning.

Disclosure of Invention

Generally, in machine learning, a predetermined algorithm is used to learn the relationship between an explanatory variable (input) and a target variable (output). Conventionally, complicated coding and expertise are required for machine learning, and the machine learning is not user-friendly.

The present disclosure has been made to solve the above-described problems, and an object thereof is to enable machine learning by a simple operation.

(Item 1) the machine learning system of the present disclosure is provided with a display device and a learning device connected to the display device. The learning device causes the display device to display a result of extracting the interpretation variable candidate and the destination variable candidate from the object file specified by the user, and causes the display device to display a result of analyzing the relativity of the interpretation variable and the destination variable selected by the user from the interpretation variable candidate and the destination variable candidate displayed on the display device by machine learning.

The learning device performs machine learning on the explanatory variable and the target variable selected by the user according to a plurality of algorithms, thereby generating a plurality of prediction models each for predicting the target variable from the explanatory variable, calculates the determination coefficients of the generated plurality of prediction models, and causes the display device to display the prediction model having the highest determination coefficient as the optimal model.

(3) In the machine learning system according to 2, the learning device causes the display device to display a plurality of algorithms, and causes the display device to display information of an optimal model or information of a selected model which is a prediction model of an algorithm selected by a user from among the plurality of algorithms displayed on the display device.

(4) In the machine learning system according to 3, the learning device obtains an interpretation variable input by the user, and causes the display device to display a result obtained by calculating a target variable corresponding to the interpretation variable input by the user using the optimal model or the selection model.

The machine learning system according to any one of the items 1 to 4, wherein the learning device obtains a division ratio of training data and test data requested by a user, and causes the display device to display a result obtained by dividing data included in the object file into the training data and the test data according to the obtained division ratio, and performing machine learning.

(6) In the machine learning system according to any one of 1 to 4, the explanatory variable is a variable related to a material of the battery, and the objective variable is a variable related to a characteristic of the battery.

(Item 7) the machine learning method of the present disclosure includes a step of causing the display device to display a result of extracting the interpretation variable candidate and the destination variable candidate from the object file specified by the user, and a step of causing the display device to display a result obtained by machine learning analysis of the relativity of the interpretation variable and the destination variable selected by the user from the interpretation variable candidate and the destination variable candidate displayed on the display device.

The above and other objects, features, aspects and advantages of the present invention will become apparent from the following detailed description of the present invention when taken in conjunction with the accompanying drawings.

Drawings

Fig. 2 is a diagram schematically showing an example of a learning execution screen displayed on the display device.

Fig. 3 is a diagram schematically showing an example of the learning availability screen displayed on the display device.

Detailed Description

Embodiments of the present disclosure will be described in detail with reference to the accompanying drawings. The same or corresponding portions in the drawings are denoted by the same reference numerals, and the description thereof will not be repeated.

[ System Structure ]

Fig. 1 is a diagram schematically showing the overall structure of a machine learning system 1 of the present embodiment.

The machine learning system 1 includes a display device 2, a keyboard 3, a mouse 4, a removable disk 5, and a learning device 6.

The learning device 6 is a device that performs machine learning. The learning device 6 includes an auxiliary device 10 and an analysis device 60. The analysis device 60 is a device that actually performs machine learning and analyzes the learning result. The assisting apparatus 10 is an apparatus for assisting the use of machine learning performed by the analyzing apparatus 60.

The auxiliary device 10 includes, as main hardware elements, a computing unit 11, a storage unit 12, a display interface 15, a peripheral interface 16, a reading unit 17, and a communication unit 18. The assist device 10 may be realized by a general-purpose computer, or may be realized by a special-purpose computer for machine learning assistance.

The arithmetic unit 11 is an arithmetic circuit (arithmetic device) for executing various processes by executing various programs, and is an example of a computer. The arithmetic unit 11 is constituted by, for example, a CPU (Central Processing Unit: central processing unit). All or a part of the functions of the computing unit 11 may be provided in a server device (not shown) (e.g., a cloud-type server device).

The storage unit 12 stores program codes, a work memory, and the like when the arithmetic unit 11 executes an arbitrary program. The storage unit 12 stores learning data 13 used for machine learning of the analysis device 60. The learning data 13 includes a plurality of combinations of the explanatory variable and the target variable.

The display interface 15 is an interface for connecting the display device 2, and inputs and outputs data between the auxiliary device 10 and the display device 2.

The peripheral device interface 16 is an interface for connecting peripheral devices such as the keyboard 3 and the mouse 4, and realizes input and output of data between the auxiliary device 10 and the peripheral devices.

The reading section 17 reads various data stored in the removable disk 5 as a storage medium. The learning data 13 is read from the removable disk 5 by the reading unit 17 and stored in the storage unit 12, for example.

The communication unit 18 transmits and receives data to and from the analysis device 60 via wired communication or wireless communication.

The analysis device 60 performs machine learning based on the received learning instruction if the learning instruction is received from the auxiliary device 10, and performs analysis of the learning result. The learning instruction includes information on the division ratio of the learning data 13, and the like, in addition to the learning data 13. The division ratio of the learning data 13 is a ratio of dividing a plurality of combined data of the interpretation variable and the target variable included in the learning data 13 into training data (data for generating the prediction model 61) and test data (data for verifying the prediction model 61).

The analysis device 60 can generate the prediction model 61 using machine learning (learning stage) or perform various processes by effectively using the generated prediction model 61 (effective use stage). The prediction model 61 is a model for predicting a target variable from an explanatory variable. The prediction model 61 outputs the value of the destination variable corresponding to the inputted explanatory variable by being inputted with the explanatory variable.

When a learning instruction is received from the auxiliary device 10 in the learning phase, the analysis device 60 reads the learning data 13 included in the learning instruction, and automatically performs preprocessing of the learning data. For example, as one of the preprocessing, the analysis device 60 performs processing of compensating the numerical value with similar data when there is a missing value in the read learning data 13. The analysis device 60 divides the data for learning after the preprocessing into training data and test data in the division ratio included in the learning instruction. Then, the analysis device 60 generates a prediction model 61 that predicts the relationship between the interpretation variable and the target variable included in the training data. Further, for example, the explanatory variable is a variable related to the material of the battery, and the objective variable is a variable related to the characteristic of the battery. By setting the variables in this manner, it is possible to generate the prediction model 61 that predicts the relationship between the material of the battery and the characteristics of the battery.

The predictive models 61 are generated separately using a variety of algorithms. That is, the analysis device 60 generates a plurality of prediction models 61 using a plurality of algorithms. Then, the analysis device 60 uses the test data to verify the generated prediction model 61. Further, the analysis device 60 analyzes the generated prediction model 61 (such as calculation of correlation coefficients and determination coefficients). The method for generating, verifying and analyzing the prediction model by the analyzer 60 is the same as the known method, and therefore, detailed description thereof will not be repeated here.

The analysis device 60, when receiving the valid use instruction including the value of the explanatory variable from the auxiliary device 10 in the valid use stage, calculates the predicted value of the target variable for the value of the explanatory variable included in the valid use instruction using the prediction model 61, and transmits the calculated predicted value of the target variable to the auxiliary device 10.

[ Assistance of machine learning ]

In the conventional machine learning tool, special knowledge such as complicated coding and machine learning process is required. However, it is difficult for general users to learn the expertise of machine learning in advance, and thus, it is not friendly to users.

Therefore, the learning device 6 of the present embodiment assists so that the user can easily perform the execution of the machine learning and the effective use of the machine learning result by a simple operation.

< Learning phase (phase of performing machine learning) >

Fig. 2 is a diagram schematically showing an example of the learning execution screen 70a displayed on the display device 2. The learning device 6 causes the display device 2 to display a learning execution screen 70a shown in fig. 2. The user can perform the machine learning performed by the learning device 6 by performing a simple operation in accordance with the display content of the learning execution screen 70a without performing complicated coding or the like. Next, the operation performed by the user while viewing the learning execution screen 70a will be described.

(1) Designation of object files

A tab 80 described as "search for prediction model" and a tab 90 described as "display of predicted value" are displayed on the learning execution screen 70a so as to be able to select them. If the user performs an operation of selecting the tab 80, a learning execution screen 70a shown in fig. 2 is displayed on the screen of the display device 2.

On the lower sides of the labels 80 and 90, a file selection icon 81a, a path display unit 81b, and a read icon 81c are displayed. When the user performs an operation of pointing the cursor at the file selection icon 81a and clicking, the storage destination and the file name of the learning data (the learning data 13) are automatically searched for and displayed on the path display unit 81 b. When there are a plurality of files of the learning data, the path display unit 81b displays the storage destinations and file names of the plurality of files. The user can simply specify the object file for machine learning by performing an operation of pointing and clicking the cursor at the portion where the desired file name is displayed. If the user performs an operation of pointing and clicking the cursor on the read icon 81c (hereinafter also referred to as "file read operation") in a state where the target file is designated, the target file is read, and the status bar 81d is popup displayed until the target file is read. At the status bar 81d, for example, the read information, the read time, and the like of the display target file are displayed.

(2) Method for dividing learning data and selection of dividing ratio

On the lower side of the file selection icon 81a, a division selecting section 82 is displayed. The user can select the division method and the division ratio of the learning data included in the read object file in accordance with the display of the division selecting unit 82.

Specifically, the division selecting unit 82 includes a method selecting unit 82a for displaying options of the division method. In fig. 2, as options of the division method, "random" of the random division learning data and "holding row number" of the division performed in a state where the arrangement order of the learning data is held are displayed, and a state where "random" is selected by default is shown. The user does not need to perform special operations in the case where the segmentation method can be maintained as default "random". The user can easily change the dividing method to the "holding line number" by performing an operation of clicking the cursor on the display portion such as the "holding line number".

Further, the division selecting section 82 includes a proportion selecting section 82b for displaying the division proportion by a scroll bar. Fig. 2 shows an example in which the default value of the division ratio (ratio of training data to the entire learning data) is "80%". The division ratio is generally set to a range of 70 to 90%. The user can arbitrarily change the division ratio by operating the scroll bar of the ratio selecting section 82b.

(3) Selection of explanatory and destination variables

A variable selecting section 83 is displayed below the division selecting section 82. When the reading of the target file is completed, processing is performed to extract the interpretation variable candidate and the destination variable candidate from the learning data included in the target file, and the title names of the extracted interpretation variable candidate and destination variable candidate are displayed in the interpretation variable selecting unit 83b and destination variable selecting unit 83a so as to be selectable, respectively.

The user can easily select an explanatory variable by performing an operation of selecting and clicking on a desired 1 or more explanatory variables (hereinafter also referred to as "explanatory variable selecting operation") from among the explanatory variable candidates displayed by the explanatory variable selecting unit 83 b. Similarly, the user can easily select a target variable by performing an operation of selecting and clicking on a desired 1 target variable from among the target variable candidates displayed by the target variable selecting unit 83a (hereinafter also referred to as "target variable selecting operation"). The interpretation variable and the destination variable selected by the user are displayed on the selection variable display unit 83 c. Hereinafter, the selection operation of the explanatory variable and the selection operation of the destination variable are also described as "variable selection operation".

The interpretation variable candidates displayed by the interpretation variable selecting unit 83b may be added later, and the machine learning result may be updated based on the added interpretation variables.

(4) Execution of machine learning (generation of predictive model)

A learning execution icon 84 is displayed below the variable selection unit 83. If the user performs an operation of causing the cursor to be aligned with the learning execution icon 84 and clicking (hereinafter also referred to as "learning execution operation") in a state where the explanatory variable and the destination variable selected by the user are displayed in the selected variable display portion 83c, the machine learning performed by the learning device 6 is executed in accordance with the learning condition (learning data, explanatory variable, destination variable, dividing method, dividing ratio, etc.) specified by the user in the learning execution screen 70 a.

The learning device 6 performs machine learning by using learning conditions specified by the user, thereby generating a prediction model (the above-described prediction model 61) for predicting a target variable from an explanatory variable. As described above, the prediction model outputs the value of the destination variable corresponding to the inputted explanatory variable by being inputted with the explanatory variable.

The learning device 6 of the present embodiment generates a plurality of predictive models using a plurality of algorithms for learning conditions specified by the user. Further, the learning device 6 calculates a correlation coefficient (an index indicating a relationship between the explanatory variable and the target variable) and a determination coefficient (an index indicating how much the predicted value of the target variable matches the actual value of the target variable) for each of the plurality of generated prediction models.

(5) Display of learning results

On the lower side of the learning execution icon 84, a result display section 85 that displays the result of machine learning is displayed. The user can confirm the result of the machine learning by observing the display content of the result display unit 85. In the result display section 85, a model name display section 85a, a coefficient display section 85b, a graph display section 85d, and a feature quantity display section 85e are displayed.

In the model name display section 85a, the name of the prediction model (algorithm) for the learning result displayed in the result display section 85 is displayed. The model name display unit 85a displays by default the name (in the example shown in fig. 2, "lar") of the prediction model (hereinafter also referred to as "best model") having the highest determination coefficient among the plurality of prediction models.

If the user performs an operation of pressing a pull-down button displayed at the right end of the model name display section 85a, a selection list 85f displaying a plurality of algorithms for generating a predictive model in order of accuracy (in order of higher to lower determination coefficients) is displayed. The user can change the learning result displayed on the result display unit 85 to the learning result obtained by the prediction model (selection model) generated by the algorithm selected by the user by selecting any one of the plurality of prediction models (algorithms) displayed on the selection list 85f.

The coefficient display unit 85b displays the correlation coefficient and the determination coefficient of the prediction model displayed by the model name display unit 85 a. The graph display unit 85d displays a graph showing the analysis result of the prediction model displayed by the model name display unit 85 a. The feature quantity display unit 85e displays a ranking of feature quantities of the prediction model displayed in the model name display unit 85 a.

< Stage of effective utilization (stage of effective utilization of machine learning result) >

Fig. 3 is a diagram schematically showing an example of the learning availability screen 70b displayed on the display device 2. If the user performs an operation of selecting the tab 90, the learning effective use screen 70b shown in fig. 3 is displayed on the screen of the display device 2. The user can calculate (predict) the value of the target variable for the value of an arbitrary explanatory variable using the prediction model generated in the learning stage, only by performing a simple operation in accordance with the display content of the learning effective use screen 70b.

On the learning effective use screen 70b, an explanatory variable input unit 91, a target variable display unit 92, a data display unit 93 for examination, and a model selection unit 94 are displayed.

In the explanatory variable input section 91, a title bar 91a, an input bar 91b, a range bar 91c, a calculation execution icon 91d, and an initial value icon 91e are displayed.

The title bar 91a, the input bar 91b, and the scope bar 91c are displayed in order from the left. In the title bar 91a, the title names of a plurality of explanatory variables are vertically arranged and displayed, and in the scope bar 91c, the minimum value and the maximum value of each explanatory variable are displayed. In the input field 91b, as an initial value, a median value of each explanatory variable is input. The user can change the value of the interpretation variable in the input field 91b from the initial value to an arbitrary value within the range displayed in the range field 91 c. Fig. 3 shows an example in which 4 items of "category B", "category a", "category e" and "category c" are set as destination variables and the other items are set as fixed values among the items displayed in the title bar 91 a.

The model selecting unit 94 displays the name of the prediction model for calculating the target variable. The model selecting unit 94 displays the optimal model by default. If the user performs an operation of pressing a pull-down button displayed at the right end of the model selecting section 94, a selection list is displayed that displays the names of the plurality of predictive models generated in the learning stage in order of accuracy. The user can change the prediction model for calculating the objective variable to the prediction model selected by the user by selecting 1 prediction model from the selection list.

If the user performs an operation of bringing the cursor into alignment with the calculation execution icon 91d and clicking (hereinafter also referred to as "calculation execution operation"), the learning device 6 performs a process of calculating the value of the target variable for the value of the explanatory variable input to the input field 91b (hereinafter also referred to as "calculation process") using the prediction model displayed in the model selection section 94. The calculated value of the target variable is displayed on the target variable display unit 92. By repeating the operation of changing the value of the explanatory variable input to the input field 91b and calculating the value of the target variable again, the user can grasp how much the target variable has changed with respect to the change in the explanatory variable. For example, in the case where the explanatory variable is a variable related to the physical property of the material of the battery and the target variable is a variable related to the storage characteristic of the battery, the user can predict how much the storage characteristic of the battery changes with respect to the change in the physical property of the material of the battery. The material physical properties of the battery refer to, for example, physical properties of the positive electrode, the negative electrode, the separator, and the electrolyte, and material physical properties of materials used in them.

[ Flow sheet ]

Fig. 4 is a flowchart showing an outline of the processing procedure performed by the learning device 6 in the learning phase. The flowchart is executed when the learning execution screen 70a shown in fig. 2 is displayed on the screen of the display device 2.

First, the learning device 6 determines whether or not the above-described file reading operation is performed (step S10). If the document reading operation is not performed (no in step S10), the learning device 6 repeats the processing in step S10, and waits for the document reading operation to be performed.

When the file reading operation is performed (yes in step S10), the learning device 6 reads the target file, extracts the interpretation variable candidate and the destination variable candidate from the learning data included in the read target file, and displays the extracted interpretation variable candidate and destination variable candidate on the display device 2so that the user can select them (step S11).

Next, the learning device 6 determines whether or not the above-described variable selection operation is performed (step S12). When the variable selection operation is not performed (no in step S12), the learning device 6 repeats the processing in step S12, and waits for the variable selection operation to be performed.

When the variable selection operation is performed (yes in step S12), the learning device 6 determines whether or not the learning execution operation is performed (step S13). When the learning execution operation is not performed (no in step S13), the learning device 6 repeats the processing in step S13, and waits for the learning execution operation.

When the learning execution operation is performed (yes in step S13), the learning device 6 executes the learning process of performing machine learning as described above (step S14). Thereafter, the learning device 6 causes the display device 2 to display the result of the learning process (step S15).

Fig. 5 is a flowchart showing an outline of the processing procedure performed by the learning device 6 in the effective use stage. This flowchart is executed when the learning effective use screen 70b shown in fig. 3 is displayed on the screen of the display device 2.

First, the learning device 6 determines whether the above-described calculation execution operation is performed (step S20). If the calculation execution operation is not performed (no in step S20), the learning device 6 repeats the processing in step S20, and waits for the calculation execution operation.

When the calculation execution operation is performed (yes in step S20), the learning device 6 performs the above-described calculation process (step S21). Specifically, the learning device 6 calculates the value of the target variable for the value of the explanatory variable input to the input field 91b, using the prediction model displayed in the model selection unit 94.

Next, the learning device 6 causes the display device 2 to display the result of the calculation process (step S22).

As described above, the machine learning system 1 of the present embodiment includes the display device 2 and the learning device 6. The learning device 6 causes the display device 2 to display a result of extracting the interpretation variable candidate and the destination variable candidate from the object file specified by the user, and causes the display device 2 to display a result obtained by machine learning to analyze the relationship between the interpretation variable and the destination variable selected by the user from the interpretation variable candidate and the destination variable candidate displayed on the display device 2.

According to the machine learning system 1 of the present embodiment, candidates of the interpretation variable and the destination variable included in the object file are displayed on the display device 2 only by the user specifying the object file. The user can cause the display device 2 to display the analysis result obtained by the machine learning by performing a simple operation of selecting a desired variable from among the interpretation variable candidates and the destination variable candidates displayed on the display device 2. Therefore, the user can perform machine learning by a simple operation without performing a complicated operation such as encoding.

Further, in the learning stage, the learning device 6 according to the present embodiment performs machine learning on the explanatory variable and the target variable selected by the user in accordance with a plurality of algorithms, thereby generating a plurality of prediction models each for predicting the target variable from the explanatory variable, calculates the determination coefficients of the generated plurality of prediction models, and displays the prediction model having the highest determination coefficient as the optimal model on the display device 2. Thus, the user can know the optimal model by a simple operation.

Further, in the learning stage, the learning device 6 of the present embodiment causes the display device 2 to display a plurality of algorithms, and causes the display device 2 to display information of the optimal model or information of the selected model generated by an algorithm selected by the user from among the plurality of algorithms. Accordingly, the user can change the information of the prediction model to be displayed on the display device 2 from the information of the optimal model to the information of the selected model by a simple operation of selecting any one of the plurality of algorithms displayed on the display device 2.

Further, in the effective use phase, the learning device 6 of the present embodiment acquires the interpretation variable input by the user, and causes the display device 2 to display the result obtained by calculating the destination variable corresponding to the interpretation variable input by the user using the optimal model or the selection model. Thus, the user can predict the value of the target variable corresponding to an arbitrary explanatory variable.

Further, in the learning stage, the machine learning system 1 of the present embodiment acquires the division ratio of the training data and the test data requested by the user, and divides the data included in the object file into the training data and the test data according to the acquired division ratio, thereby performing machine learning, and causes the display device 2 to display the result. Thus, the user can arbitrarily determine the division ratio of the training data and the test data.

The embodiments of the present invention have been described, but it should be understood that the embodiments disclosed herein are illustrative in all respects, and not restrictive.
